title: Your bookings
signedOut: Check the timetables without an account. To book, cancel and see your history, sign in with your email or create an account in a minute.
empty: No upcoming bookings. Pick a free turn in the availability.

dialog.title: Book {{facility}}
dialog.needLogin: You need to sign in to book.
dialog.acceptRules: I have read and accept the rules of use.
dialog.noRules: This facility has no specific rules: the council's general rules apply.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel the booking?
cancelDialog.description: {{facility}}, {{day}} at {{time}}. The turn will be free for someone else.

changeDialog.title: Change booking at {{facility}}
changeDialog.description: Now {{day}}, {{start}}–{{end}}. Pick another free time; the people who joined, the QR and the invite link stay with the booking.
changeDialog.closedDay: Closed this day. Pick another date.
changeDialog.cancelUntil: You can change or cancel it until {{date}}.

qr.title: Entry QR
qr.alt: QR code for the booking at {{facility}}
qr.hint: Show it to the reader at the entrance, from 15 minutes before the start until the end of the booking.
qr.brightness: If the reader does not pick it up, turn up the screen brightness.
qr.email: It also comes in the confirmation and reminder emails.

checkin.title: Check in
checkin.intro: This facility takes these ways in. Use whichever is at hand.

entry_code.title: Entry code
entry_code.help: Type the code shown at the door or the desk. We will ask for your location: it is checked and never stored.

printed_qr.title: QR at the door
printed_qr.help: Open the camera and point it at the QR printed on the door. Then we ask for your location, which is checked and never stored.

reader.title: Your booking’s QR
reader.help: Hold this QR up to the reader at the entrance.

staff.title: Facility staff
staff.help: Tell the staff your name and they will mark you in.
